kind=estimate share about half with |rho|>0.2. Code does not compute per-category rhos - it runs only one aggregate PCE VAR (VAR(...,12) on PCEPI/DPCERA) and has no 136-category data. Value is hard-coded to paper's 0.5, not derived from data. Comment directly above admits: `# vague shares - provided as paper's descriptive statements, computed from aggregate illustration is not possible for distribution, but we report paper's values as descriptive proxies`

kind=estimate share about 80% with |rho|<0.4. Same - no per-category estimation; aggregate data cannot produce distribution. Hard-coded to paper's 0.8 (≈0.8), not computed.
